title: I Am Legend
author: Richard Matheson
summary: Robert Neville seems to be the last man alive in Los Angeles after a plague has turned everyone else into nocturnal vampire-like creatures. He spends his days fortifying his house and hunting them, and his nights trying to endure.
readIf: you like short, bleak survival stories that treat loneliness as the real horror.
skipIf: you want the action of the films, since the book is slower, more reflective and quite downbeat.

pairings.reason: A spare story of survival in a ruined world, with the same bleakness and a very personal focus.
A more traditional vampire novel with a small town at its centre.
A wider, global view of a plague that overturns civilisation, told as interviews.
